prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1065; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change. The reported mechanism is consistent with the head trauma and symptoms described, including headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating in the days after the event. Over the course of 16 visits, care followed a typical concussion pathway: initial assessment, symptom monitoring, graduated activity guidance, and vestibular and cognitive reassessment. Certain examination findings, including reduced balance performance and tenderness on palpation, support the clinical picture, while other neurological screening tests returned within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury to the head or neck region. Visit frequency decreased steadily as symptoms resolved and functional goals were met. Billed services align with the documented treatment plan, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified in the record. Discharged to self-management with return precautions.
